Nobody should have to worry that seeking medical care could lead to unexpected financial ruin. A new federal law I supported protects consumers from surprise medical bills for emergency care & treatment by out of network providers.
https://t.co/tgGgfpbf2H

The #BidenAdministration has secured 500 million more #covidtests & will announce a plan to distribute free masks for all Americans. Overwhelmed hospitals will also receive support. This is the action we need to get through the #omicron wave.

https://t.co/v7xOUL7ARn

Surprise medical billing is history. I supported the No Surprises Act to ban surprise billing in private insurance for most emergency care & require that uninsured & self-pay patients receive key information about health care costs. Learn more 👇

https://t.co/7j0OTGDAlW

Our #HealthcareHeroes should never have to worry about whether they have enough supplies to tend to patients or keep themselves safe. The #AmericaCOMPETES Act improves our medical #SupplyChains with increased domestic production & strengthens the Strategic National Stockpile. https://t.co/dMpnYQtQhC
This just in: Affordable Care Act coverage has improved health outcomes AND increased economic growth! “Obamacare “Anniversary  https://t.co/ct2AAmDRWd

12 years ago, @POTUS44 signed the #AffordableCareAct into law. 370,000 PA residents have enrolled in the #ACA since & now have access to quality healthcare because of it. The #ACA also banned insurance companies from discriminating against people with pre-existing conditions. https://t.co/MKIpxFQGKw

As of today, more than 59 Million Americans with #Medicare Part B will have access to FDA-approved over-the-counter #COVID tests FOR FREE. The fact sheet at this link has more info & tells you how you can take advantage of this new Medicare initiative: https://t.co/2X5l1FCvTd

If the leak's real, #SCOTUS is going to repeal #RoeVWade – an earthshattering change which most Americans oppose and which would harm women's access to healthcare. I voted for the #WomensHealthProtectionAct – a bill which would codify #Roe into law. #WomensRightsAreHumanRights

.@EnergyCommerce CAT Subcommittee just approved my bill, the Spectrum Innovation Act, which would help produce faster mobile #broadband speeds and better coverage for consumers. It would also fund new 911 capabilities for our first responders. I’ll keep pushing until it’s law.

A study in @PNASnews concluded that more than 330,000 lives would have been saved if the US had had #UniversalHealthCare. During #Covid, many Americans lost their insurance when they lost their jobs - and then they lost their lives. We must do better.
https://t.co/MlB8HGgjlw

I'm pleased that Congress has passed the #PACTAct with my strong support. Veterans exposed to toxic substances overseas shouldn’t have to worry about getting healthcare for it from the VA. The #PACTAct will provide these brave men & women with the care & resources they need. https://t.co/FPuFEFcZgZ

Here are a few things the Bipartisan #SaferCommunities Act will do to help save lives:
✅ Support state red flag laws
✅ Protect victims of domestic abuse
✅ Enhance background checks for 18-20 year old’s
✅ Community-based violence prevention
✅ Invest in mental health services https://t.co/tJqsjS1bFv

The #SupremeCourt decision to overturn #RoeVsWade rejects decades of established precedent & ends the right of 30 million women to make their own healthcare decisions. #PA should ensure a woman's #righttochoose, and I will continue to fight against the radical right-wing agenda.

Today @POTUS signed the Bipartisan #SaferCommunities Act, which I voted for. It will:
✅ Support state red flag laws
✅ Protect victims of domestic abuse
✅ Enhance background checks for 18-20 year old’s
✅ Community-based violence prevention
✅ Invest in mental health services https://t.co/OHJccp4Vj7

⚕️More than 50% of US adults report that they've gone into debt due to medical bills
⚕️25% owe more than $5,000
⚕️20% expect to never be able to pay their debts off
We need to do better. We need to make #healthcare affordable for everyone! #ExpandACA

The #RepublicanAgenda is dangerous. It would:
🚨Gut Social Security
🚨Obliterate reproductive rights
🚨Strip health coverage from millions
🚨Prevent lower prescription drug prices
🚨Raise taxes on the middle class
🚨Reverse environmental protections
We cannot let this happen.

#AntimicrobialResistance is a growing global health risk as viruses & other diseases are increasingly resistant to drugs & antibiotics. My bill, the PASTEUR Act, would make the investments needed to ensure the medicines needed to avoid a public health crisis are developed.

6,000,000 more Americans, including 9,000 Pittsburghers, were able to enroll in ACA healthcare plans last year thanks to the #AmericanRescuePlan. The #ARP also helped each enrollee save an average of $800/year on premiums. I'm fighting to make these #healthcare credits permanent.

I support @POTUS's executive order directing @HHSGov to protect women's access to contraception, patient privacy, & emergency care. These steps support a woman's right to choose & fight against extreme abortion restrictions.
https://t.co/2I8oC03hBx

Inflation is unacceptably high. That’s why my fellow @HouseDemocrats and I are working to pass bills to reduce the cost of everyday expenses like prescription drugs💊, utility bills🔌, & health insurance premiums⚕️.

While Republicans look to ban & criminalize abortion in all 50 states, @HouseDemocrats are voting to pass the Women's Health Protection Act & the Ensuring Women's Right to Reproductive Freedom Act to protect & codify a woman's right to choose & her right to privacy.

Infectious disease experts agree the next public health crisis could be caused by drug-resistant bacteria. That's why I introduced the PASTEUR Act: to encourage the development of critically needed antibiotic drugs. It's literally a matter of life & death.
https://t.co/oSY5Zfh5Pd

Criminalizing interstate travel for U.S. citizens is un-American & downright dystopian - but today's Republican party wants to control who you love, what decisions you make about your health, & where you can travel.
Protect #AbortionAccess. Protect women.
https://t.co/D2O8ljEbyd

Today I voted for the #WHPA & the Ensuring Women's Right to Reproductive Freedom Act to protect:
🚨from Republicans criminalizing women
🚗interstate travel for legal abortion services
⛑️those helping others travel 
🩺health care providers caring for patients 
⚕️#AbortionAccess https://t.co/aMwc5afoFC

Starting TODAY Pittsburghers can call or text 9-8-8 during a mental health, substance use, or suicide crisis. It's a lifeline for help & support available 24/7. You are not alone!
